summary: Iteration 4 (P2 features: revenue chart, jewellery photo upload, audit log) tested end-to-end. All 22 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows for Dashboard revenue chart, Audit page (nav+render+filters), and PhotoUploader visibility (edit-only) all verified. Storage happy-path (upload -> photos field on booking -> file serve -> delete) works. Max-5 photos cap, content-type reject, oversize reject all fire. Booking/branch/user regression endpoints intact.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — Select component renders spans inside native <option>. Not blocking, but should be cleaned up.

Initial Recharts ResponsiveContainer warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1)' fired briefly on first paint before layout settled. Chart renders correctly after; consider providing minWidth/minHeight or checking parent flex sizing.

action_items: (Low priority) Fix Radix/native Select rendering that puts <span> inside <option> to eliminate the hydration console warning.
(Low priority) Add minWidth/minHeight to RevenueChart's ResponsiveContainer to silence the initial recharts warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~970 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting routers (bookings, users, branches, files/photos, audit, stats) into separate modules.
log_action swallows all exceptions silently (logging.warning only). Acceptable for best-effort auditing but no retry/dead-letter — flag for future.
requests library is used synchronously inside asyncio.to_thread for object storage; fine but adds thread overhead. Could switch to httpx.AsyncClient for consistency.
/api/files/{id} passes JWT via query string (?auth=). Acceptable for tags but note that query-string tokens can leak into server logs. Consider short-lived signed URLs in a future iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter4 tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_p2.py. Run with `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest backend/tests/test_iteration4_p2.py`. Storage service was reachable in this env — happy-path upload works. If it becomes flaky, the endpoint validation tests (content-type/size/max-count) still run before the storage call and remain deterministic.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all features working as spec'd.
